instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On a rocky shore next to the sea, the man in the light blue shirt (R1) stands on the left in profile, looking out to the right. Next to him, the blonde woman in the pink floral dress (R2) also stands in profile looking right, her long dress billowing forward in the strong wind. The couple is positioned close together on the rocky ground. The scene is illuminated by soft, overcast daylight, creating a cool-toned, natural atmosphere.
